<a id="Parameter"></a>

## `Parameter`

```silk
pub interface Parameter
```

A value admitted as a package parameter: text, boolean, fixed-width integer, enum, option, list,
or a record of those values. An empty implementation derives an enum or a record's public fields.
Records and enums also implement `Schema` so deferred values can be cached and restored.

<a id="Parameter.parameter"></a>

### Operation `parameter`

```silk
effect fn parameter(self: &Self) -> ParameterValue
    ! StepFailure
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Encodes the value without losing its nominal enum identity, integer precision, or optional layers.

<a id="deferred"></a>

## `deferred`

```silk
pub effect fn deferred<T: Schema + Parameter + Transferable + 'static>(
  value: Deferred<T>,
) -> Deferred<ParameterValue>
  ! StepFailure
  ? &mut Allocator
```

Preserves the producer dependency while encoding the parameter only when the graph runs.
